scope: Randomized variants of the 2 to 5 target requests of the Fury and Arms Warrior reference builds and their hand-edited variants (validation/2026-10-06-multi-target-warrior-sweep/*.base.json, application revision 3923f70de): 16 for each of 12 bases at 200 iterations (seed 20261006, and 20261008 for the three multidot and in-front bases), and 40 for each of four Cleave bases at 600 iterations (seed 20261007, renamed SPEC-N-sweepb-XX), each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. The sweep sets every copy of the boss to the variant's level, so the targets stay identical.
generator: python3 tools/sweep.py validation/2026-10-06-multi-target-warrior-sweep/SPEC-N-targets.base.json --seed 20261006 --count 16 --iterations 200 --max-distance 5 --output <scratch>/SPEC-N for each base but the multidot and front ones, whose seed is 20261008, and --seed 20261007 --count 40 --iterations 600 for the bases arms-warrior-5, warrior-5, arms-warrior-clap-3 and arms-warrior-clap-nowm-4 into a second scratch folder; each variant <scratch>/SPEC-N/sweep-XX.json is compared as SPEC-N-sweep-XX.request.json, and the second set as SPEC-N-sweepb-XX.request.json
rerun: python3 tools/prepared_v2.py compare --output <scratch> <variants>/*.request.json, with the variants renamed as the generator says

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: No variant differs from Go. The bases with Cleave against 3 to 5 targets and the party Windfury Totem have extra attacks cast a queued Cleave from inside its own damage loop, which Go's shared results slice and result cache answer for, and Rust models, in the first iterations of a run.
